notes: Pattern: business words in Spanish with Spanish 'De' order; UI-kind/technical suffixes stay English and go last (Form, Modal, Dialog, Options, Label(s), Icon, Input, Api, Store, Service, UseCase, Data, Loading, Success, Map, Cache, Spy, Req, Response, Observable, Effect, Change, Submit, Click, Preview, UI), matching phase 5a (MetricaDeAgenteData, AdjuntoPreviewModal, ContactoUI).

Generic English words not in the glossary but not domain terms are translated plainly (name->nombre, show->mostrar, more->mas, file->archivo, connection->conexion, optimistic->optimista, threshold->umbral, default->POR_DEFECTO, refresh->refrescar, canonical->canonico, requested->solicitado, multiple->varios, back->volver). Only domain/product terms the glossary lacks (dashboard, delivery, composer, kpi, phone number id) force a keep.
Label(s) kept English (ESTADO_LABELS, estadoLabel) to avoid clashing with Tag->Etiqueta.

Service-holding fields are named after the phase-5a class: agentApi/agentService -> disponibilidadApi (DisponibilidadApiService), contactsApi -> contactoApi, workflowApi -> flujoDeTicketApi, reportsApi -> reporteApi, messageSender -> envioDeMensajes, retryUseCase -> reintentarMensajeUseCase, sendUseCase -> enviarMensajeUseCase, mediaUrlService -> urlDeAdjuntoService.

buildTimeFilterParamsUseCase / createBuildTimeFilterParamsUseCase use 'construir' to mirror phase-5a class ConstruirFiltroDeTiempoParamsUseCase, although the glossary now says build->armar (buildOptimisticMedia -> armarAdjuntoOptimista). Consider renaming the class to ArmarFiltroDeTiempoParamsUseCase and these to armar...
counts/Count -> conteo(s) everywhere (glossary counts->conteos): newMessagesCount -> conteoDeMensajesNuevos, updateUnreadCount -> updateConteoDeNoLeidos, loadMoreCount -> conteoDeCargarMas.
Boolean progress states: resolving -> resolviendo, savingAgents -> guardandoAgentes (gerund); entity-being-acted-on signals use the glossary 'enEdicion' pattern: assigningTeam -> equipoEnAsignacion.
newStatus -> nuevoEstado (idiomatic 'next status'), unlike adjective-after elsewhere (mensajesNuevos, contactosNuevos).
idOfContact (track function) -> trackByContacto, since '<entidad>Id' would read as a value and 'idDe...' is forbidden.
contactById -> contactoById ('By' kept as technical query suffix, as in findByResponsable).
executeLink/executeUnlink -> executeVincular/executeDesvincular ('execute' stays English per glossary).
assignedIds -> agenteAsignadoIds, pendingWorkspaceIds -> espacioDeTrabajoPendienteIds, agentIds -> agenteIds (adjective before Id).

Collision check: no two old names map to the same new name within one file, and no new name already exists as an identifier in the declaring files (.ts/.html). agentApi and agentService both -> disponibilidadApi but live in different classes (configuracion.store/ticket-list vs disponibilidad.store).

String-name uses the rename tool will not follow: ticket-card.component.spec.ts setInput('availableAgents') and setInput('canAssign') must change to 'agentesDisponibles'/'puedeAsignar' in the same commit.
phoneInput -> telefonoInput: viewChild('phoneInput') reads the '#phoneInput' template ref by string; the string may stay or be renamed together with the template ref.

JSON-overlapping names renamed as locals/params/members only (agentId, agentName, contactId, teamId, workspaceId, isAvailable, media, mediaId, mediaKey, newStatus, ownerName, status, phone, profile, notifications, autoReply...): string keys such as params.set('teamId'), params.set('status'), formControlName='phone'/'message', route params 'contactId'/'status', SettingsTab 'profile'/'workspace' are NOT identifiers and must stay; shorthand object literals get expanded by the tool.

Inputs/outputs renamed (attachment, contact, filters, canAssign, availableAgents, participationOpen, resolving, lastInboundMessageAt, assign, retry, loadMore, filterChange, teamChange, editContact, openConversation, sendMessage, sendWithFile, toggleParticipation, retryRequested) change template binding names; strictTemplates production build is the control.
logout -> cerrarSesion only renames the method; the /api logout route string stays.
